subject: Get the fitted values on a natural scale

messages.author: f2474553d6c29da6
messages.subject: Get the fitted values on a natural scale
parts:
Hi, how can I obtain the fitted values from a Poisson spatio-temporal model fitted in INLA?
My formula model is like that: 
cases ~ 1 + offset(log(population)) + spatial_effect + temporal_effect + spatio-temporal_effect

I could get the fitted values, and they are like in the image. 
So they aren't on the scale that I want, and I'm struggling with syntax issues.
Any suggestion?

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Get the fitted values on a natural scale
parts:
it should be something like this. note that link=1 is needed for
response is NA as described in the 'old faq' vignette (I believe)


y=1:10; x = log(y)
> r=inla(y ~ 1 + x , data=data.frame(y,x), family="poisson",
control.predictor=list(link=1))
> r$summary.fitted.values$mean
[1] 1.071092915 2.015182505 2.968713919 3.939023129 4.927457498
[6] 5.933968208 6.958094026 7.999255834 9.056859421 10.130333311
> y[10]=NA
> r=inla(y ~ 1 + x , data=data.frame(y,x), family="poisson",
control.predictor=list(link=1))
> y[10]=NA
> r$summary.fitted.values$mean
[1] 1.076335393 2.007529678 2.954991105 3.925979468 4.921511365
[6] 5.941223620 6.984384218 8.050183326 9.137828866 10.246577899
